Growing tomatoes on a small balcony

Posted on September 3, 2026 by Rosa

You do not need a garden to grow tomatoes. A sunny balcony and a large pot are enough for a surprising harvest.

Choose the right variety

Cherry tomatoes and compact bush varieties stay small and still produce plenty of fruit.

  • Use a pot that holds at least twenty liters of soil
  • Water deeply in the morning rather than a little every evening

The best fertilizer is the gardener's shadow.

Old proverb
